column1: # Managed paths and ownership in a consumer.
# PINNED: required content matches the shipped body.
# SEED: written when absent, then owned by the project.
# SECTION: the leading marked block is owned; the remainder belongs to the project.
# REFERENCE: optional file containing only a reference to AGENTS.md.
# FORBIDDEN: a local configuration that could shadow the harness must not exist.
# REPOSITORY: root only. APPLICATION: each application. PAYLOAD: each Payload member.
